The plate looks like a square side plate of about 22 cm. It holds scrambled egg whites, or possibly a soft cheese or an egg-white omelette, plus about 5 pieces of cantaloupe or papaya.

The egg whites take up roughly 40% of the plate and look about 2 cm thick, so I estimate around 120 g. At about 50 kcal per 100 g, that is roughly 60-70 kcal.

The orange fruit is about 5 chunks at roughly 20 g each, so 100 g. At about 35 kcal per 100 g, that is roughly 35 kcal.

That gives about 220 g total and about 100 kcal. The pale mass could instead be a cheese-like or fattier food such as scrambled eggs with milk, which would raise the energy. I'll allow for that and settle on about 130 kcal.
